_what: Bylines the publisher has approved for the archive `author` field, by post ID. These pieces are filed under a house WordPress account, so post_author cannot supply the name; it lives only in the article body. Nothing is inferred at export time - a record is renamed only if its ID appears here.
_ruling: 2026-08-15 publisher ruling. Corroborated = the same name was read independently from two or three of: the caption Author:, the image alt text, and the 'About the Author' block. Single-source extractions were explicitly NOT approved and are not in this file - a wrong name invents a person, where the house label merely fails to name one.
_scope: Changes `author` only. content_html and content_sha256 are untouched; correction_status is set; record_sha256 is recomputed. This is alignment of a false machine label, not a back-dated determination about independence.
